sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是《99%隐形》。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: I swear to fulfill, to the best of my ability and judgment, this covenant.
sentences.zh: 我发誓，将尽我所能和判断力，履行这一誓约。

sentences.en: A man must have a code, no doubt.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问，一个人必须有自己的准则。

sentences.en: The fundamental ethical precept of medicine is that doctors first do no harm.
sentences.zh: 医学的基本伦理准则就是医生首先要做到不伤害。

sentences.en: This led the American Medical Association to adopt Opinion 2.06 of the AMA Code of Medical Ethics in 1992.
sentences.zh: 这促使美国医学会在1992年采纳了其医学伦理准则第2.06条意见。

sentences.en: An individual's opinion of capital punishment is the personal moral decision of that individual.
sentences.zh: 个人对死刑的看法是其个人的道德决定。

sentences.en: A physician, as a member of a profession dedicated to preserving life, when there is hope of doing so,
sentences.zh: 医生作为致力于维护生命的职业成员，在有希望挽救生命时，

sentences.en: should not be a participant in a legally authorized execution.
sentences.zh: 不应参与法律授权的处决。

sentences.en: It goes on from there.
sentences.zh: 此后还有更多内容。

sentences.en: Lawyers have an ethics code.
sentences.zh: 律师有职业道德准则。

sentences.en: Journalists have an ethics code.
sentences.zh: 记者有职业道德准则。

sentences.en: So it shouldn't surprise you that architects do as well.
sentences.zh: 所以，建筑师也有职业道德准则，这不应让你感到惊讶。

sentences.en: The relevant ethical standard from the AIA that we're discussing is ES 1.4, human rights.
sentences.zh: 我们正在讨论的美国建筑师协会（AIA）相关伦理标准是ES 1.4，即人权。

sentences.en: Members should uphold human rights in all their professional endeavors.
sentences.zh: 会员应在所有职业活动中维护人权。

sentences.en: A number of architects have taken a stance that there are some buildings that just should not have been built.
sentences.zh: 许多建筑师持有一种立场，认为有些建筑根本就不该被建造。

sentences.en: And they don't just mean the ugly buildings.
sentences.zh: 他们指的不仅仅是那些丑陋的建筑。

sentences.en: That by design, they violate standards of human rights.
sentences.zh: 而是指这些建筑在设计上就违反了人权标准。

sentences.en: That's our producer Sam Greenspan.
sentences.zh: 那是我们的制作人萨姆·格林斯潘。

sentences.en: He's talking about prisons.
sentences.zh: 他在谈论监狱。

sentences.en: Specifically, prisons that keep inmates alone in cells with little to do and with minimal human contact.
sentences.zh: 具体来说，是那些将囚犯单独关押在牢房里，无事可做且几乎没有人类接触的监狱。

sentences.en: Inmates have names for these places.
sentences.zh: 囚犯们对这些地方有自己的称呼。

sentences.en: The Box or the Bing.
sentences.zh: “盒子”或“禁闭室”。

sentences.en: On the outside, we know them as Supermax or the SHU.
sentences.zh: 在外面，我们称之为“超级监狱”或“安全住房单元”（SHU）。

sentences.en: That's S-H-U for Security Housing Unit.
sentences.zh: 也就是S-H-U，代表安全住房单元。

sentences.en: Now it's up for debate as to whether or not the SHU is solitary confinement.
sentences.zh: 现在，关于SHU是否属于单独监禁还存在争议。

sentences.en: Reason being, and this is something weird we found while researching the story,
sentences.zh: 原因在于——这是我们在研究这个故事时发现的一个奇怪现象——

sentences.en: there is no legal definition for solitary confinement.
sentences.zh: 法律上并没有对单独监禁的定义。

sentences.en: The UN doesn't have one.
sentences.zh: 联合国没有定义。

sentences.en: The Department of Justice doesn't have one.
sentences.zh: 司法部没有定义。

sentences.en: And neither does the CDCR, the California Department of Corrections and Rehabilitation.
sentences.zh: 加州惩教与康复部（CDCR）也没有定义。

sentences.en: The CDCR maintains that no prisoners in California are kept in solitary confinement.
sentences.zh: CDCR坚称加州没有任何囚犯被关在单独监禁中。

sentences.en: They refer to the SHU as a, quote, segregation unit.
sentences.zh: 他们把SHU称为“隔离单元”。

sentences.en: But a number of groups, including Amnesty International and Human Rights Watch,
sentences.zh: 但包括国际特赦组织和人权观察在内的许多组织，

sentences.en: do call the SHU solitary confinement.
sentences.zh: 确实将SHU称为单独监禁。

sentences.en: And there's a lot of controversy surrounding one SHU at a Northern California prison called Pelican Bay.
sentences.zh: 北加州一所名为鹈鹕湾的监狱里的SHU引发了大量争议。

sentences.en: Pelican Bay State Prison was designed by San Francisco-based architecture firm KMD.
sentences.zh: 鹈鹕湾州立监狱是由旧金山的建筑事务所KMD设计的。

sentences.en: KMD declined to speak to us for this story.
sentences.zh: KMD拒绝就此事接受我们的采访。

sentences.en: But Jim Muller, an architect with KMD who worked on Pelican Bay,
sentences.zh: 但KMD参与鹈鹕湾项目的建筑师吉姆·穆勒，

sentences.en: did talk with Architect Magazine about the prison.
sentences.zh: 确实曾与《建筑师杂志》谈论过这座监狱。

sentences.en: He said, quote,
sentences.zh: 他说，引用如下：

sentences.en: The inmates have no contact with other inmates during the vast majority, if not all, of the day.
sentences.zh: “囚犯在一天中的绝大部分时间，如果不是全部时间，都无法与其他囚犯接触。”

sentences.en: They are only allowed out of their cells for very short periods of time
sentences.zh: “他们只有在极短的时间内才被允许离开牢房，

sentences.en: for constitutionally required exercise periods.
sentences.zh: 用于宪法规定的锻炼时间。”

sentences.en: End quote.
sentences.zh: 引用结束。

sentences.en: Life inside of a SHU means 22 to 23 hours a day inside of a tiny room, 80 or so square feet.
sentences.zh: 在SHU里的生活意味着每天22到23小时被关在一个80平方英尺左右的小房间里。

sentences.en: Nancy Mullane, a radio reporter with Life of the Law,
sentences.zh: 南希·穆兰，《法律人生》的一名电台记者，

sentences.en: managed to get access to the SHU in Pelican Bay State Prison in California.
sentences.zh: 设法进入了加州鹈鹕湾州立监狱的SHU。

sentences.en: She went inside one of the cells and had an inmate, Robert Luca, describe the room.
sentences.zh: 她走进其中一间牢房，让囚犯罗伯特·卢卡描述了这个房间。

sentences.en: Basically, it's the cell, I don't know what size, 6x9 or 6x12, whatever it is.
sentences.zh: “基本上，这就是牢房，我不知道多大，6x9英尺或6x12英尺，随便吧。”

sentences.en: And that's, your bunk is your living room.
sentences.zh: “你的铺位就是你的客厅。”

sentences.en: The center of it is your walking area.
sentences.zh: “中间是你的活动区域。”

sentences.en: And two steps to the right is your bathroom, pretty much.
sentences.zh: “往右走两步就是你的厕所，差不多就是这样。”

sentences.en: The official measurements are actually 7 1⁄2 by 12 feet.
sentences.zh: 官方测量数据实际上是7.5英尺乘12英尺。

sentences.en: It's not a space that's designed to keep you comfortable.
sentences.zh: 这个空间的设计初衷并不是为了让你感到舒适。

sentences.en: But it's not these architectural features that concern humanitarian activists and psychiatrists.
sentences.zh: 但让这些人道主义活动家和精神科医生担心的并不是这些建筑特征。

sentences.en: It's the amount of time many prisoners spend in that cell alone, without any meaningful activity.
sentences.zh: 而是许多囚犯在牢房里独自度过的时间，没有任何有意义的活动。

sentences.en: Long-term solitary confinement, which is either for months or years, or it goes on forever, as at Pelican Bay,
sentences.zh: 长期单独监禁，无论是持续数月、数年，还是像在鹈鹕湾那样无休止地持续下去，

sentences.en: connected with absolute idleness.
sentences.zh: 都与绝对的无所事事联系在一起。

sentences.en: That is, the individual is socially isolated to the extreme, but also has nothing meaningful to do.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，个人在社会上被极端孤立，同时也没有任何有意义的事情可做。

sentences.en: And this causes human breakdown.
sentences.zh: 这会导致人的崩溃。

sentences.en: This destroys people as human beings.
sentences.zh: 这会摧毁作为人类的个体。

sentences.en: Terry Coopers is a psychiatrist who specializes in forensic work.
sentences.zh: 特里·库珀斯是一位专门从事法医工作的精神科医生。

sentences.en: That is, he's an expert on the intersection of mental health and criminal justice.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，他是心理健康与刑事司法交叉领域的专家。

sentences.en: He served as an expert witness on more than 20 class action lawsuits concerning prison conditions.
sentences.zh: 他曾在20多起关于监狱条件的集体诉讼中担任专家证人。

sentences.en: He says there's a whole litany of effects that solitary can have on a person.
sentences.zh: 他说，单独监禁对一个人会产生一系列的影响。

sentences.en: Massive free-floating anxiety, paranoid ideas, insomnia, depression, and suicidal thoughts are very prominent.
sentences.zh: 巨大的游离性焦虑、偏执观念、失眠、抑郁和自杀念头非常突出。

sentences.en: Their eyes are destroyed because if you do not look at a distance for a long length of time, your eye deteriorates.
sentences.zh: 他们的视力被摧毁了，因为如果你长时间不看远处，眼睛就会退化。

sentences.en: They have concentration and memory probleMs.
sentences.zh: 他们有注意力和记忆力问题。

sentences.en: And I ask if they read, and they'll say no, because I can't remember what I read three pages earlier.
sentences.zh: 我问他们是否阅读，他们会说不，因为我不记得三页前读过什么。

sentences.en: Mounting anger, and they almost universally report that they're terrified that their anger will get out of control.
sentences.zh: 愤怒不断积聚，他们几乎一致表示，他们非常害怕自己的愤怒会失控。

sentences.en: They'll be in more trouble, and then they'll have a longer term in solitary.
sentences.zh: 那样他们会惹上更多麻烦，然后在单独监禁中被关更久。

sentences.en: And that's just for a normal, stable person.
sentences.zh: 而这还只是针对一个正常、稳定的人。

sentences.en: For prisoners with a history of or predisposition to mental illness, solitary can bring on a breakdown.
sentences.zh: 对于有精神疾病史或易患精神疾病的囚犯来说，单独监禁会导致崩溃。

sentences.en: Now again, there is no universally accepted definition of solitary confinement.
sentences.zh: 再次强调，目前没有关于单独监禁的普遍公认定义。

sentences.en: And Life of the Law reporter Nancy Mullane says that compared to other prisons she has visited,
sentences.zh: 《法律人生》记者南希·穆兰说，与其他她参观过的监狱相比，

sentences.en: there are actually some good design elements in the Pelican Bay shoe.
sentences.zh: 鹈鹕湾的SHU实际上有一些不错的设计元素。

sentences.en: Inmates can get natural light from skylights outside of their cells, which drifts in through the doors made of perforated metal.
sentences.zh: 囚犯可以从牢房外的天窗获得自然光，光线通过穿孔金属门射入。

sentences.en: These porous doors allow for inmates to communicate with each other,
sentences.zh: 这些多孔的门允许囚犯之间进行交流，

sentences.en: even though there are no lines of sight to any prisoner from within the cell.
sentences.zh: 尽管在牢房内无法看到任何其他囚犯。

sentences.en: But on the other hand, cells don't have windows.
sentences.zh: 但另一方面，牢房没有窗户。

sentences.en: Inmates never get to see the horizon.
sentences.zh: 囚犯永远看不到地平线。

sentences.en: The only time prisoners get to leave the cell is to visit the shower or the exercise yard.
sentences.zh: 囚犯离开牢房的唯一时间就是去淋浴或去运动场。

sentences.en: And the exercise yard is an empty, windowless room, not much bigger than a cell, with 20-foot-high concrete walls.
sentences.zh: 而运动场是一个空荡荡、没有窗户的房间，比牢房大不了多少，墙壁是20英尺高的混凝土墙。

sentences.en: And while many prisoners in the shoe have a cellmate, Terry Coopers says sharing a cell is often worse than being alone.
sentences.zh: 虽然SHU里的许多囚犯有室友，但特里·库珀斯说，共用一个牢房往往比独自一人更糟糕。

sentences.en: So if that's not solitary confinement per se, you could call it a kind of binary confinement.
sentences.zh: 所以如果这本身不叫单独监禁，你可以称之为一种“二元监禁”。

sentences.en: And all of this taken together, some people call torture.
sentences.zh: 把所有这些加在一起，有些人称之为酷刑。

sentences.en: In 2011, Juan Mendez, the UN Special Rapporteur on Torture, said anything over 15 days.
sentences.zh: 2011年，联合国酷刑问题特别报告员胡安·门德斯表示，任何超过15天的监禁，

sentences.en: 15 days in solitary confinement is a human rights abuse.
sentences.zh: 在单独监禁中待满15天就是一种侵犯人权的行为。

sentences.en: Now, various other commentators have said that means it's torture.
sentences.zh: 现在，其他各种评论员都说这意味着这就是酷刑。

sentences.en: 15 days, says the UN, is the point at which people in solitary can begin to have irreparable psychological damage.
sentences.zh: 联合国表示，15天是单独监禁中的人开始遭受不可逆转的心理损害的时间点。

sentences.en: I don't actually like the 15-day standard.
sentences.zh: 我其实并不喜欢15天的标准。

sentences.en: Some people fall apart in two days.
sentences.zh: 有些人两天就崩溃了。

sentences.en: And what Terry Coopers calls torture happens in buildings specifically designed to maximize the isolation or
sentences.zh: 特里·库珀斯所说的酷刑发生在那些专门设计用于最大化隔离的建筑中，或者

sentences.en: quote-unquote segregation of prisoners for the duration of their time in the shoe.
sentences.zh: 所谓的在他们待在SHU期间对囚犯进行“隔离”。

sentences.en: So if it is the ethical code of architects to promote human rights, what is their responsibility to the people who are incarcerated in their buildings?
sentences.zh: 那么，如果建筑师的职业道德准则要求促进人权，他们对被关在自己设计的建筑里的人有什么责任？

sentences.en: In Argentina, the military regime tortured people in a former auto body shop.
sentences.zh: 在阿根廷，军政府曾在一家前汽车修理厂里折磨人。

sentences.en: That was one of their big torture centers.
sentences.zh: 那是他们的大型酷刑中心之一。

sentences.en: I'm not going to, nobody's going to say that the architects who designed the auto body shop are somehow responsible,
sentences.zh: 我不会，没有人会说设计那家汽车修理厂的建筑师要对此负责，

sentences.en: or even that the car mechanics who just own it are.
sentences.zh: 甚至连拥有它的汽车修理工也不负责。

sentences.en: No, of course not.
sentences.zh: 不，当然不是。

sentences.en: This is Rafael Sperry.
sentences.zh: 这是拉斐尔·斯佩里。

sentences.en: But when solitary confinement is a practice that requires a certain kind of space,
sentences.zh: 但当单独监禁成为一种需要特定空间的操作时，

sentences.en: and when you're specifying the space exactly for that and making sure that all the doors can be operated without,
sentences.zh: 当你明确指定空间就是为了这个目的，并确保所有的门都可以在不看到另一个人，

sentences.en: you know, seeing another human being, that the outdoor space is going to be one that's occupied by one person at a time,
sentences.zh: 你知道，不看到另一个人，确保户外空间一次只能由一个人占用，

sentences.en: that there's nowhere for a group of people to actually be together, so it just won't happen,
sentences.zh: 确保没有地方让一群人真正聚在一起，所以这种情况根本不会发生，

sentences.en: then that is a design intent.
sentences.zh: 那么这就是一种设计意图。

sentences.en: When used as intended, human rights violations will result.
sentences.zh: 当按预期使用时，就会导致侵犯人权的结果。

sentences.en: Rafael Sperry is an architect here in San Francisco, and he's the president of a group called ADPSR.
sentences.zh: 拉斐尔·斯佩里是旧金山的一名建筑师，他是ADPSR组织的负责人。

sentences.en: Architects, designers, and planners for social responsibility.
sentences.zh: 即“建筑师、设计师和规划师社会责任组织”。

sentences.en: A few years back, Rafael had been following the news from Guantanamo Bay and weeding up on mass incarceration in the U.S.,
sentences.zh: 几年前，拉斐尔一直在关注关塔那摩湾的新闻，并阅读关于美国大规模监禁的资料，

sentences.en: not necessarily as an architect per se, just as a civic-minded, social justice-oriented kind of guy.
sentences.zh: 不一定是以建筑师的身份，只是作为一个有公民意识、倾向社会正义的人。

sentences.en: And then, one day in 2010, he saw an article in the San Francisco Chronicle about the redesign of San Quentin Prison in California.
sentences.zh: 然后，2010年的一天，他在《旧金山纪事报》上看到了一篇关于加州圣昆廷监狱重新设计的文章。

sentences.en: So, yeah, the Chronicle actually ran a picture that was supplied by the corrections department that was the CAD model.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，《纪事报》确实刊登了一张由惩教部门提供的图片，那是CAD模型。

sentences.en: A kind of three-dimensional floor plan.
sentences.zh: 一种三维平面图。

sentences.en: Of the execution chamber suite of rooMs.
sentences.zh: 关于死刑执行室套房的房间。

sentences.en: And I was like, they're using the same tools that I use to make residential additions for people,
sentences.zh: 我当时想，他们正在使用我用来为人们做住宅扩建、建造学校的工具，

sentences.en: to make schools, only this project is going to kill people.
sentences.zh: 只是这个项目是要杀人。

sentences.en: That was totally shocking.
sentences.zh: 这太令人震惊了。

sentences.en: Seeing the remodel of the death chamber was the catalyzing event,
sentences.zh: 看到死刑室的改造是催化事件，

sentences.en: but you could argue that there's a difference between designing a death room and designing a shoe.
sentences.zh: 但你可以争辩说，设计死刑室和设计SHU是有区别的。

sentences.en: But Sperry views both as immoral and in violation of the human rights that architects swear to uphold.
sentences.zh: 但斯佩里认为两者都是不道德的，违反了建筑师发誓要维护的人权。

sentences.en: Rafael Sperry wants architects and the profession of architecture as a whole, at least in the U.S.,
sentences.zh: 拉斐尔·斯佩里希望建筑师和整个建筑行业，至少在美国，

sentences.en: to stop building shoes or any structures that are designed for long-term solitary confinement
sentences.zh: 停止建造SHU或任何旨在进行长期单独监禁的结构，

sentences.en: or are designed to put people to death.
sentences.zh: 或者旨在处决人的结构。

sentences.en: He's not talking about all prisons or jails,
sentences.zh: 他不是在谈论所有的监狱或看守所，

sentences.en: just the ones where isolation is baked into the physical structure,
sentences.zh: 只是那些将隔离融入物理结构的监狱，

sentences.en: like the AIA architect-designed shoe at Pelican Bay Prison.
sentences.zh: 比如鹈鹕湾监狱里由AIA建筑师设计的SHU。

sentences.en: Pelican Bay State Prison is way up in Northern California near the Oregon border,
sentences.zh: 鹈鹕湾州立监狱位于北加州，靠近俄勒冈州边境，

sentences.en: hours from any major city.
sentences.zh: 距离任何大城市都有数小时的路程。

sentences.en: It opened in 1989 to house the so-called worst of the worst,
sentences.zh: 它于1989年开放，用于安置所谓的“最坏中的最坏”，

sentences.en: suspected gang members,
sentences.zh: 疑似帮派成员，

sentences.en: and people who are seen to pose the greatest threat to officers and other inmates.
sentences.zh: 以及被认为对警官和其他囚犯构成最大威胁的人。

sentences.en: It was modeled after a prison in Arizona
sentences.zh: 它是仿照亚利桑那州的一所监狱建造的，

sentences.en: and has since inspired design for other prisons across the country,
sentences.zh: 此后启发了全国其他监狱的设计，

sentences.en: even buildings in Guantanamo Bay.
sentences.zh: 甚至是关塔那摩湾的建筑。

sentences.en: Life of the Law's Nancy Mullane had Corrections Officer Lieutenant Rick Graves
sentences.zh: 《法律人生》的南希·穆兰在2012年参观鹈鹕湾时，让惩教官里克·格雷夫斯中尉

sentences.en: describe his take on the purpose of the shoe when she visited Pelican Bay in 2012.
sentences.zh: 描述了他对SHU目的的看法。

sentences.en: The key to making this design work in our favor
sentences.zh: “使这种设计发挥作用的关键，

sentences.en: is not just the design of it, but how it's managed.
